rubrics.justification: It correctly identifies a blastocoel and notes poor prognosis consistent with 1DD, but it inaccurately states distinct inner and outer cell layers are visible and highlights a grading contradiction without resolving morphology in detail; the response is also incomplete.
The visible response does not integrate patient age, ovarian reserve, male factor, cycle type, or endometrium with embryo quality.
Reasoning is limited and partially contradictory, focusing on inconsistency between numeric expansion grade and text description without developing a coherent overall assessment.
It references Gardner grading appropriately and recognizes poor-quality blastocyst features, but the incomplete response prevents full assessment of evidence-based recommendations.
No practical transfer or future-cycle recommendations are provided in the visible response.
